title: Backend Development — Beginner
description: Learn Node.js fundamentals and build your first Express applications.

sections.title: Node.js Fundamentals
sections.description: Understand what Node.js is and how it executes JavaScript outside the browser.
learning_objectives: Explain the Node.js runtime and V8 engine

sections.title: npm & Modules
sections.description: Manage dependencies and organize code using modules.
learning_objectives: Install and manage packages with npm

sections.title: Asynchronous JavaScript
sections.description: Learn callbacks, Promises, and async/await for non-blocking code.

sections.title: Event Loop & Concurrency
sections.description: Understand how Node.js handles concurrency on a single thread.
learning_objectives: Explain the phases of the event loop
Reason about blocking vs non-blocking code
Understand the call stack and task queue

sections.title: Express Basics
sections.description: Build your first web server using Express.

sections.title: Routing & Middleware
sections.description: Organize routes and use middleware for shared logic.
learning_objectives: Define routes for multiple HTTP methods

sections.title: API Fundamentals
sections.description: Learn the basics of designing simple JSON APIs.

title: Backend Development — Intermediate
description: Build real REST APIs with authentication, database integration, and solid architecture.

sections.title: REST API Design
learning_objectives: Apply REST conventions and resource naming

sections.title: Authentication & Authorization
sections.description: Implement login flows and control access to resources.

sections.title: Database Integration
sections.description: Connect Express applications to a database using an ORM.
learning_objectives: Perform CRUD operations from an API

sections.title: Middleware & Error Handling
sections.description: Apply middleware patterns for validation, logging, and centralized error handling.

sections.title: Backend Architecture Patterns
sections.description: Structure backend applications using layered architecture.
learning_objectives: Separate controllers, services, and data access

sections.title: Backend Testing
sections.description: Write unit and integration tests for API endpoints.
learning_objectives: Write unit tests for business logic
Write integration tests for API routes

title: Backend Development — Advanced
description: Design secure, scalable backend systems and handle production-grade concerns.

sections.title: Scalable Backend Architecture
sections.description: Design backend systems that scale under load.

sections.title: Backend Security
sections.description: Protect Express applications from common vulnerabilities.
learning_objectives: Mitigate injection and XSS-style risks in APIs
Apply secure session and token handling
Harden HTTP headers and CORS policy

sections.title: Node.js Performance & Scaling
sections.description: Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks in Node.js services.
learning_objectives: Apply clustering and load balancing concepts

sections.title: Advanced Database Integration Patterns
sections.description: Apply advanced patterns for reliable database-backed services.
learning_objectives: Design for data consistency under concurrency

sections.title: Production Readiness
sections.description: Prepare backend services for real-world production operation.
learning_objectives: Plan graceful shutdown and error recovery

sections.title: Advanced Testing & Reliability
sections.description: Apply advanced testing strategies to ensure backend reliability.
learning_objectives: Design a test strategy across unit/integration/e2e
Apply contract testing concepts for APIs
